title: Debt MF bought Jun-2023 and redeemed after 27 months: s.50AA deems it short-term, taxed at slab
covers: deemed STCG regardless of holding period
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.50AA (inserted by Finance Act 2023 w.e.f. AY 2024-25; definition of 'specified mutual fund' amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024 w.e.f. AY 2026-27 to a fund investing > 65 % in debt/money-market instruments): gain on units acquired on/after 1-Apr-2023 is deemed short-term capital gain
Deemed STCG on a non-s.111A asset: slab rate
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2025 s.2)
derivation: Buy 2023-06-01: 1,000 units @ 20.00 -> cost 20,000.00 (acquired after 1-Apr-2023; fund is a debt fund, > 65 % debt under both the old and new definitions).
Held 27 months, but s.50AA deems short-term -> term short, rate slab.
